_source: app_config and categories. NOT customer/order counts.
_why: The mock quotes 50K+ customers, 5K+ vendors, 25K+ daily orders and 15+ cities. None of those exist — the platform has a handful of test records — and printing them would be a claim the database contradicts. These four are facts the platform genuinely commits to, and they fill the same band without inventing a customer.
